title: ricinocarpus mollis

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and infections. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential applications of this plant.
